versions.changelog:
Initial release of Generate Product Mockup Photos.

- Create polished ecommerce mockup images with clean backgrounds and consistent framing.
- Supports generating product photos for launches and catalog pages.
- Workflow guides on audience clarification, draft generation, and refinement.
- Uses an image generation API for producing mockup photos.
- Ideal for startups, solopreneurs, and agencies needing on-brand product images.
